name: Amana Una
source:
Amana Una is a visual novel that tells the story of a young man named Otávio.

After his parents die in an suspicious accident, Otávio finds himself forced to go live in Iúna with his grandfather whom he hates. There he meets his childhood friends and has the opportunity to relive some moments of the happiest time of his life.

However he will finds himself in a net of conspiracies deeper than he ever imagined.

[From Patreon (Removed)]
translation:
Amana Una是一部视觉小说，讲述了一个名叫Otávio的年轻人的故事。

父母在一场可疑的事故中去世后，奥塔维奥被迫前往尤纳与他讨厌的祖父一起生活。在那里，他遇到了儿时的朋友，并有机会重温他一生中最快乐的时光。

然而，他会发现自己陷入了比他想象的更深的阴谋网中。

[来自Patreon（已删除）]
